status: Historical local record for the 0.18.0 clock budget fix and published guest selection. Experimental 0.18.0 publication, deployment, native production shell recovery and local Minutei delivery are tracked in sdk-0.18.0-delivery.json.

guest.scope: Explicit software test/proof selection. Sandboxes and Minutei do not automatically install this package.

nativeProductionBinding.scope: Native default service binding for filesystem/process actions, plus the existing Agent RPC callbacks, persistent contexts and terminal proofs. This ran before the native clock change, against the documented 0.17.0 deployment.

nativeProductionSoftware.scope: Authenticated HTTP API, with functions/loops, shell and jq composition, scripts, descriptor execution, file effects and explicit scoped reclamation.

reproduction.symptom: Reedline failed with WASI host request budget exceeded before saving its interactive checkpoint.
reproduction.initialFixtureIssue: Preloaded cursor responses did not satisfy every native DSR query. The fixture now answers actual observed queries through native stdin writes before advancing to the handover deadline.

change.clockObservations: Clock requests do not consume the I/O request allowance. They still use the native Effect clock and Wasmi fuel.
change.remainingBudget: Randomness, polling, filesystem work and other suspended host requests retain the shared 256-call ceiling.
change.clockDriver: The optional acknowledged-output marker keeps the request-local native TestClock at small steps during terminal negotiation, then advances to the original absolute handover deadline. Existing fixtures retain their first-output behavior.
change.terminalWrites: Cursor replies complete without interruption; accepted stdin offsets are read from the native owner before subsequent writes.

clockRegression: 257 subsequent random requests fail with acknowledged clock output retained
an infinite clock loop fails by Wasmi fuel

checks: R2-backed checkpoint at the existing lease boundary
old Worker closed before replacement opens the same native store
partial command resumes with retained output
first command output and file append occur once
duplicate native Queue delivery retains the identical result and file

fullCheck.scope: Native build, SDK build, TypeScript, Clippy with warnings denied, Cargo tests and the complete two-worker native Bun suite.

localVerification.benchmark: bun run bench passed; complete report in shell-clock-budget-benchmark-local.json, without a before/after or production performance claim.

limits: The 0.18.0 clock budget change and rebuilt-guest interactive recovery are local proofs until the matching runtime is delivered.
The production binding/software runs validate the rebuilt shell on runtime 0.17.0; they do not establish the 0.18.0 interactive recovery behavior in production.
The marker-clock coordination is test-only and does not add a production timing flag.
The shared non-clock host-request ceiling, total fuel, deadlines and capability expiry still bound sessions; arbitrary indefinite execution is not established.
No production cost, latency, maximum-memory or AgentOS performance comparison is claimed.
